protocol: select on one fold, report on the other, pool; image-level DOTA VOC07 mAP@0.5 budget

rules.risk: backbone with the highest PR-AUC on the selection fold, identity calibration, cheapest threshold whose paired-bootstrap 5th-percentile mAP@0.5 change on the selection fold is within the budget (200 image resamples); headline
rules.risk_full: same bootstrap rule searched over every backbone, calibration map and threshold
rules.plain_full: cheapest candidate over every backbone, calibration and threshold whose point estimate on the selection fold is within the budget
